method_limits: No pixel-equality claim between different presentations.
Native video time resampled to fixed 240 Hz, at most one simulation tick error.
Timing, damage RNG and initial-contact mismatches are reported, never silently aligned.
Source state names are not assumed equivalent.

evidence_levels.measured: Native RAM/video and prototype traces with identical input schedule.
evidence_levels.provisional: Prototype rules listed in its current calibration and notes.

rea_role: Archive inventory/provenance only. No native input routine reconstructed in step 1.
